subject.title: fix(discord): bound event listener slots after timeout

question: Should Discord maxConcurrency bound actual unresolved listener work after listenerTimeout, accepting queue saturation when every listener is permanently hung?
rationale: The patch correctly enforces a true in-flight-work cap, but timeout cannot cancel listener promises, so this deliberately chooses bounded concurrency over guaranteed queue progress.

options.title: Accept strict active-work bound
options.body: Merge this policy so timed-out listeners retain slots until settlement, with process restart remaining the recovery for permanently hung listeners.

options.title: Require abortable listener execution
options.body: Pause the PR and design listener cancellation or a bounded post-timeout lease before changing slot-release behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept strict active-work bound
recommendation.body: Merge this policy so timed-out listeners retain slots until settlement, with process restart remaining the recovery for permanently hung listeners.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord runtime and test history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the queue availability contract.
